strings.Начало координат (0, 0) в левом верхнем: The origin (0, 0) in the top-left corner, the x axis to the right, the y axis down; a view rectangle inside.

strings.Дерево наследования: NSObject, UIRespond: The inheritance tree: NSObject, UIResponder, then UIView, UIViewController and UIApplication, below them UIWindow, UIControl, UIScrollView and their descendants.

strings.Вложенная view child внутри superview: f: A nested view child inside a superview: frame (20, 30, 100, 100) in the parent's coordinates, bounds (0, 0, 100, 100) in its own, and the child has its own top-left corner (0, 0).

strings.Дерево view: UIWindow содержит корневую: The view tree: UIWindow contains the view controller's root view, which holds a UILabel and a UIView card, and the card holds a UIImageView and a UIButton.

strings.UIApplication содержит UIWindowScene, за: UIApplication contains UIWindowScene, then UIWindow, rootViewController, its view and subviews.

strings.Один point на разных экранах: при scale: One point on different screens: at scale 1.0 it is one pixel, at 2.0 a 2-by-2 grid, at 3.0 a 3-by-3 grid of pixels.

strings.Приложение на главном потоке выполняет l: The app on the main thread performs layout, display and prepare, then commit sends the layer tree to the Render Server; it renders the frame through the GPU and gets the finished frame back.

strings.Дерево view (UIView, UILabel, UIImageVie: A view tree (UIView, UILabel, UIImageView) and a layer tree (three CALayers); dashed layer arrows lead from each view to its layer.

strings.Линия жизни контроллера: init, запрос vi: A controller's timeline: init, the view request with loadView, viewDidLoad once; a single-transaction group with viewWillAppear; a layout group with viewIsAppearing, viewWillLayoutSubviews and viewDidLayoutSubviews; the transition animation and viewDidAppear.

strings.Цепочка при добавлении view в показанный: The chain when adding a view to a displayed superview: init, addSubview, willMove toSuperview, willMove toWindow, didMoveToSuperview, didMoveToWindow, layoutSubviews and draw, if it is overridden.

strings.Constraints задают правила, Auto Layout: Constraints set the rules, Auto Layout solves the system, which gives each view's frame, and layoutSubviews applies the result.

strings.До: у подписи и поля hugging 250, растян: Before: the label and the field both have hugging 250, either view can stretch, two outcomes. After: the label has 251, the field 250; the label keeps its size, the field stretches.

strings.Три фазы подряд: update constraints сниз: Three phases in a row: update constraints bottom-up, layout top-down, display top-down.

strings.Твой код дважды вызывает setNeedsLayout:: Your code calls setNeedsLayout twice: the view sets a flag and returns immediately, the repeated call collapses. In the next cycle the run loop calls layoutSubviews once. layoutIfNeeded calls layoutSubviews immediately if the flag is set.

strings.Схема: view проверяется на скрытость, от: A diagram: the view is checked for being hidden, interaction disabled and alpha below 0.01, then for the point falling within bounds; if the checks pass, the subviews are traversed from top to bottom. If one returned a view, that deep view is returned, otherwise self; if the checks fail, nil is returned.

strings.Палец касается экрана, система передаёт: A finger touches the screen, the system passes UIApplication a UIEvent with a UITouch, UIApplication calls sendEvent on UIWindow, the window starts hitTest and gets the found view, then sends it touchesBegan, touchesMoved and touchesEnded.

strings.Дискретный жест: possible переходит в re: A discrete gesture: possible goes to recognized or failed. A continuous one: possible, began, changed many times, then ended or cancelled; from began you can go straight to ended.

strings.Окно сначала отправляет касания распозна: The window first sends touches to the gesture recognizer. If the gesture is recognized, the remaining touches to the view are cancelled via touchesCancelled; if not recognized (failed), the touches are delivered to the view.

strings.Цепочка респондеров идёт вверх: UIButton: The responder chain goes upward: UIButton, superview, the controller's root view, UIViewController, UIWindow, UIApplication and AppDelegate if it is a UIResponder.

strings.Ячейка, ушедшая за край экрана, попадает: A cell that went off the screen edge goes into the reuse queue. When a cell is needed for a new row, it checks whether the queue has a cell of the needed type: if so, it is taken and prepareForReuse is called, if not, a new one is created. Then the content is configured in cellForRowAt.

strings.Экран A передаёт данные вперёд на экран: Screen A passes data forward to screen B via init, a property or a segue. Screen B returns data back to screen A via a delegate, a closure or a notification.

strings.Главный поток обрабатывает событие и обн: The main thread handles an event and updates the UI, then comes the Core Animation commit, then the render server: the CPU prepares work, the GPU draws the frame, and the frame reaches the screen on the next vsync.
